topic: Dipped Beam Light Error Status and Switch Process Parameters
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific service interface or process related to dipped beam light functionality, detailing its parameters, associated controllers/modules, and operational status.
column_semantics: Columns represent different aspects of the service/process: the first column is the function/module name, followed by columns indicating which system (SOA, ICB, LHZCU) consumes the service, and finally a column for network fault status.

core_entities.name: DippedBeamLight.DippedBeamLightErrorStatus
core_entities.description: Service interface to query the error status of the right-side dipped beam light.

core_entities.name: ExteriorLightSwitchProcess.DippedBeamLightErrSta
core_entities.description: Process to query the error status of the dipped beam light during exterior light switching.

core_conditions.name: Network Fault Status
core_conditions.description: Indicates whether there is a network fault affecting the communication of the service/process.

core_outputs.name: DippedBeamLightErrorSta
core_outputs.description: Error status parameter for the dipped beam light, with values: 0x0=No Error, 0x1=Error, 0x2=Unknown.

core_outputs.name: DippedBeamLightErrSta
core_outputs.description: Error status parameter for the dipped beam light during switch process, with value: 0x0=No Error.

core_faults.name: Dipped Beam Light Error
core_faults.description: Indicates an error condition in the dipped beam light system.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the parameters and interfaces for querying the error status of the dipped beam light system, both as a standalone service and as part of the exterior light switch process. It is used to verify that the correct error status is returned under normal and fault conditions.
uncertain_points: The exact behavior when 'Network Fault Status' is active is not specified.
The relationship between the two 'DippedBeamLightErrorSta' parameters (one for each service/process) is not clearly defined.
